name: TrueSignal lateral movement attempt against a decoy
description: An SSH or RDP login against a decoy (ATT&CK tactic TA0008 in the Hub's mapping). Decoys mirror production hosts and have no users, so a remote-services login means a host on the network is moving laterally.
author: TrueSignal
false_positives: Jump hosts or automation that sweep subnets with SSH (Ansible inventories that include the decoy range). Remove the decoy range from inventories; add the scanner to known scanners only if it is a scanner.
note:
## Triage
1. `source.ip` is the moving host. Contain it first if it is a server or a privileged workstation; `truesignal.source_asset` names it when inventoried.
2. `user.name` (RDP: `mstshash`/NTLM identity, `truesignal.details.workstation`) and SSH key fingerprints (`truesignal.details.key_fingerprint`) identify the credential or key in use.
3. Check the same source against real SSH/RDP servers (Falcon `UserLogon`, Windows 4624/4625 type 10) in the same hour.
query: event.dataset:"truesignal.alert" and threat.tactic.id:"TA0008" and not truesignal.whitelisted:true and not truesignal.known_scanner:true
